query: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI funding rounds announced or reported in June-July 2026, and any imminent/expected funding rounds in July 2026
answer:
Research complete. Here's the bottom line on funding activity for the three companies in the June–July 2026 window:

**Mistral AI** is the only one of the three with an **imminent/in-progress equity round**: seeking ~€3B at a ~€20B valuation (first reported by Bloomberg June 12, 2026), with the newest development being FT's July 22–23, 2026 report that **Samsung is in advanced talks to invest up to ~€1B** (alongside EQT, Novo Holdings, and Santander; ASML already holds ~11%). The round was **not yet closed** as of July 25, 2026.

**OpenAI** and **Anthropic** announced **no new equity rounds** in June–July 2026. Both had closed record rounds earlier in 2026 (OpenAI: $122B/$852B in March; Anthropic: $65B/$965B Series H in May) and spent the June–July window on **IPO preparation** — OpenAI filed a confidential S-1 on June 8, and Anthropic filed confidential IPO paperwork around June 1.

key_facts: OpenAI announced no new funding round in June-July 2026; its last equity round closed March 31, 2026 at $122B raised / $852B post-money valuation.
OpenAI's June-July 2026 activity was IPO prep: it confidentially filed a draft S-1 with the SEC on June 8, 2026, targeting an IPO valuation reportedly up to $1 trillion.
Anthropic announced no new funding round in June-July 2026; its last round (Series H) was announced May 28, 2026 at $65B raised / $965B post-money valuation.
Anthropic confidentially filed draft IPO paperwork around June 1, 2026, positioning for a possible fall 2026 public debut.
Mistral AI is in an active/imminent funding round: seeking ~€3B (~$3.5B) at a ~€20B (~$22.8B) valuation, first reported by Bloomberg on June 12, 2026.
On July 22-23, 2026, the Financial Times reported Samsung in advanced talks to invest up to ~€1B in Mistral's new round.
Reported additional participants in Mistral's round include EQT (Scaleup Europe Fund), Novo Holdings, and Santander; existing shareholder ASML holds ~11%.
Mistral's round was NOT yet closed as of July 25, 2026 (still in negotiation).
Anthropic briefly became the world's most valuable startup at $965B, surpassing OpenAI's $852B, in May 2026.
Mistral's targeted €20B valuation would nearly double its €11.7B post-money mark set in its September 2025 Series C led by ASML.
